verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Tax offering a natural-language command interface. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, an MCP server and a CLI are documented, but these are developer building blocks and claims belonging to other stories (MCP server, CLI, LLM-readable docs). They are not a product-provided way to operate Stripe Tax with natural-language commands, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
